  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"Only R03 holds, establishing the Card family. No other adverse or Context rule holds; household exceptions are unnecessary, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The issuing-country mismatch and failed CVV warranted verification, but legitimate use of a foreign-issued card is the strongest competing explanation. Under §6.6(b), id_check was the sole required check, and it passed. Section 5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check. No further check is needed."
